_comment: Bot names (config keys, ids or older free-form names) for the deep-link resolver's isMemberName (deep-link.js). isMemberName admits every name the gateway can hold (is_readable_member_name in src/kiro_crew/members_parts/member_space.py) and refuses control and line-break characters and every format character except ZWNJ, ZWJ, LRM and RLM, which pass only where the gateway keeps them, beside non-ASCII text. deep-link.test.js runs both lists through isMemberName; test/test_cli_open.py runs them through is_readable_member_name. Length caps are tested in code, not here.
